systems.platform: mHealth (offline-first Android app, SMS synchronisation), mHealth Africa
systems.tiers: Gouré health district: 139 organisational units, including integrated health centres (CSI) and community health posts; used by community health workers, with CSIs reporting supply needs through it

note: The system described is a community health worker application (household surveys, antenatal visits, community IMCI, stock, referrals), class community, so it gives no hmis or emr fact. The vendor's account, published 2026-05-18, says the Gouré rollout is full-scale over 139 units and that before it community monthly reports reached the district on paper, weeks late; it does not say mHealth exchanges data with the HMIS in Niger.
